prompt_context: You are filling Gmail Mail1 fields for CoreStar cold outreach. The script will assemble the final email body from approved blocks, so do not rewrite the whole email body.
extra_prompt_rules: Choose only from the allowed Mail1_Variant values.
Use only information present in the provided row data.
Do not invent campaign names, specific videos, or performance claims.

subject_patterns.campaign_oriented: Paid Collaboration: Q2 AI Projects x {display_name} - CoreStar Agency
subject_patterns.neutral_partnership: Creator Partnership Inquiry: {display_name} x CoreStar Agency
subject_patterns.fit_first: Potential AI Campaign Fit: {display_name} x CoreStar Agency

sender_intro.agency_positioning_intro: I'm Steve from CoreStar Agency, where we help AI and tech brands work with creators whose audiences are a real fit.
sender_intro.light_commercial_intro: I'm Steve from CoreStar Agency, and I'm reaching out regarding upcoming AI creator partnerships.

credibility_block.standard_credibility:
Our team has a strong track record in the AI and tech ecosystem.
We have delivered high-impact campaigns for leading brands including Skywork AI, Kling AI, Seedance, Alibaba, and TikTok.
credibility_block.fit_first_credibility: We work closely with AI and tech brands that care about audience fit and content quality, not just broad reach.
credibility_block.short_credibility: We support AI and tech brands on creator partnerships across campaign sourcing, fit assessment, and execution.

variant_body.shortlist_soft: We are currently building out our shortlist for upcoming AI creator campaigns, and I would love to keep your profile in consideration where there is a strong audience fit.
variant_body.rates_direct: Given the alignment here, I would love to understand your current rates for dedicated videos and integrations.
variant_body.fit_soft: That is why I thought your profile would make sense to keep on hand for upcoming AI partnerships where fit matters more than broad distribution alone.
variant_body.fit_direct: Because the content fit already looks strong, I wanted to reach out directly and understand your current collaboration rates and preferred formats.

ask_intro.full_intake_intro: Could you please send over the following:
ask_intro.media_kit_first_intro: If you're open, I would love to review the following first:
ask_intro.rates_first_intro: If available, could you share the following:

full_intake: Links to all your active social channels
rates_first: Your current rates for dedicated videos and integrations
Any up-to-date media kit or audience overview if available

closing.standard_closing: If there is a fit for an upcoming project, I would be happy to follow up with the exact brief and timeline.
closing.fit_first_closing: If there is a good fit, I can follow up with the exact product brief and commercial context before asking you to commit to anything.
